analysis: The host completed all 25 epochs successfully; the best checkpoint was at epoch 5. Validation HR@10 was 0.605, below the prior 0.615 result by 0.010 and the reported best of 0.625 by 0.020. The depth-aggregation experiment therefore failed the retention criterion and should be rejected. Intermediate-feature mixing did not improve this run; the result does not establish whether feature dilution, optimization changes, or another effect caused the decline. Final learned aggregation weights were not reported.
code_summary: Causal NextItNet with 64-dimensional item and positional embeddings, eight independent residual blocks using dilations [1,2,1,2,1,2,1,2], kernel size 3, LayerNorm, gated GELU transformations, and dropout 0.2. The experiment adds trainable, input-independent softmax aggregation across masked block outputs, initialized to weight the final block at 90% and earlier blocks collectively at 10%, followed by final normalization and masking. Item embeddings remain tied to scoring. MAXLEN=128, LR=0.001, WEIGHT_DECAY=0.0, and BATCH_SIZE=128; interfaces and frozen host behavior are preserved.
